source_law.text: Unless otherwise provided by ordinance of the local authority having jurisdiction, a person shall not: Stop, stand or park a vehicle in any other alley in such a manner, or under such conditions as to leave available less than 10 feet of the width of the alley for the free movement of vehicular traffic.
